newsitem.title: USA: Wild Oats to buy three Arizona stores.
newsitem.headline: Wild Oats to buy three Arizona stores.

text.p: Wild Oats Markets Inc said Thursday it has signed an agreement to buy three natural foods supermarkets in Phoenix, Ariz., from privately held Reay's Ranch Markets.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.
Wild Oats, a natural foods supermarket chain based here, said the stores will be renamed Wild Oats Community Markets when the deal closes.
Reay's Ranch will continue to operate three Tucson, Ariz., stores that are not part of the transaction, it said.
The latest acquisition will raise the number of stores Wild Oats operates to 50 in 11 states and British Columbia, Canada, it said.
